rosh-hashana-yom-kippur-9-12-96.note: recites the verse "vayehi erev vayehi boker"
He explicitly names 'the Mishna' as introducing an upcoming metaphor; context after describes the shepherd/sheep inventory metaphor found in Mishna Rosh ha-Shana 1:2 (Bene Maron).
Quotes the Mishna's phrase 'kol ba'ei olam overin lefanav kivnei maron' with translation.
